assay: mRNA-Seq (transcription) and ribosome profiling / Ribo-Seq (translation), Ion PGM, mouse gastrocnemius
primary_estimand: Effect of a single 60-min treadmill run (20 m/min), sampled immediately after exercise, versus no exercise on (a) mRNA abundance and (b) ribosome-protected-fragment (translation) abundance, analysed separately per assay
sample_inclusion: Sequencing used only no-exercise and immediately-after-exercise groups; each biological replicate = pooled lysate of 3 mice; 2 replicates per condition per assay (S2.3.p1, S4.p1). The 1h/2h/4h groups were used only for qPCR/western blot.
planned_contrasts: exercise vs no exercise, transcription level (mRNA-Seq) (S3.p4; paper: 26 DEGs at P < 0.01)
exercise vs no exercise, translation level (RPF) (S3.p4; paper: 37 DEGs at P < 0.01)
repeated_measure_unit: none; replicates are independent 3-mouse pools; mRNA and RPF of one replicate share a lysate but are analysed separately
normalization: edgeR TMM (S2.7.p1); genes filtered to > 125 RPM, n = 1011 (S2.6.p2, S2.7.p1, FIG3)
paper_method: edgeR with TMM normalization, exercise vs no exercise per assay on the 1011 genes > 125 RPM; test type not stated

named_genes.Slc25a25: up ~4 fold mRNA, ~18 fold RPF (S3.p5, FIG4)
